leaflet.title: Pharmacy leaflet: how to take the antibiotic
leaflet.source: Take one tablet twice a day, with food, for seven days, even if you feel better sooner. Do not drink alcohol while you are taking this medicine. If you get a rash or find it hard to breathe, stop taking the tablets and call your doctor straight away.

tenancy.title: Tenancy notice: rent and deposit
tenancy.source: The rent is 750 pounds a month, paid on the first day of each month. The deposit of 1,500 pounds is returned within ten days of the end of the tenancy, minus the cost of any damage.

sign.title: Shop sign: opening hours
sign.source: Open Monday to Saturday from 9 am to 6 pm. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.
